title: ophrys lutea subsp. subfusca
intro: Ophrys lutea subsp. subfusca, commonly known as the Yellow Bee Orchid, is a type of orchid that belongs to the Ophrys genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been found to provide health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects, aiding in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys lutea subsp. subfusca include its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms of dyspepsia, as well as its use as a diuretic to help reduce fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to fully understand its therapeutic potential.
